Student engagement sequences (wide format)

Source: R/data.R
engagement.Rd

engagement is a synthetic dataset of the engagement states of 1,000 students over a study program, generated to resemble the engagement trajectories analyzed by Saqr, López-Pernas, Helske and Hrastinski (2023). It has one row per student and one column per time point (23 to 25 observed states per student). Each state is "Active", "Average" or "Disengaged"; missing values occur only at the end of a row.

Usage

engagement

Format

A data.frame with 1,000 rows (students) and 25 character columns T1 to T25, holding "Active", "Average", "Disengaged" or NA.

Source

The engagement sequence object of the tna package, converted to character with its void and missing codes set to NA (identical values).

References

Saqr, M., López-Pernas, S., Helske, S., & Hrastinski, S. (2023). The longitudinal association between engagement and achievement varies by time, students' profiles, and achievement state: A full program study. Computers & Education, 199, 104787. doi:10.1016/j.compedu.2023.104787

See also

trajectories for a smaller engagement dataset; context_tree().

Examples

tree <- context_tree(engagement, max_depth = 3, min_count = 20)
tree
